title: Question 28
passage:
Which adapter did you use to charge the lantern?
A. It took less than an hour. B. I charged it on the porch. C. The white one with the short cord.
passageZh:
你用哪個電源轉接器幫那盞提燈充電？
A. 充不到一小時。 B. 我是在門廊充的。 C. 白色、接短線的那個。
